condition: Mechanical verification. Planner has the complete transition model. A winning trace is a reachability witness; a planner loss does not prove unreachability. No enjoyment conclusion.
shallowScope: Every legal two-action sequence from seed 1 of all three scenarios and four historical rules versions.
witnessScope: Shipped rules: all scenarios, seeds 1–12. Historical rules: each scenario at seed 1.
limitations: Two-turn enumeration cannot prove absence of deeper transition bugs.
Witnesses cover a finite seed set, not every uint32 seed.
Historical solver losses are unresolved searches, not evidence of unavoidable losses.
This validates rules and replay; human readability and enjoyment need separate evidence.
